method: All imported road roles classified independently of material and width. Actual rendered support at 25 cm chainage; bridge exact mesh overrides DEM. 2.6 m axle span and nominal 14 cm belly clearance sampled without adding cars. Width estimates retained as estimates; no traffic permission inferred from width. High/irregular grades remain flagged, not flattened. This is not a complete vehicle collider or surveyed clearance certification.
